# Build System and Package Structure

The build page explains how the repository is packaged, built, exported, and prepared for local development or distribution.
## Purpose and Scope
This area explains how the repository is built, packaged, and exposed to consumers. It covers scripts, config files, package entrypoints, and the delivery shape readers need before they publish or self-host the project.
## What Lives Here
- `package.json` - Package manifest that defines scripts, entrypoints, exports, and dependency boundaries.
- `packages/blade-better-auth/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-cli/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-client/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-codegen/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-compiler/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-hono/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
- `packages/blade-syntax/package.json` - Repository file related to this page.
## Build Inputs
- `build` runs `turbo build` and creates the production build or compiled package artifacts.
- `check` runs `biome check --error-on-warnings` and supports the project workflow.
- `dev` runs `turbo dev --filter='./packages/*' --concurrency 24` and starts the local development workflow.
- `test` runs `turbo test` and runs verification for expected behavior.
- `typecheck` runs `turbo typecheck` and supports the project workflow.
- `format` runs `biome format --write` and checks or fixes code style before changes are shipped.
- `prepare` runs `turbo build` and supports the project workflow.
